pythonFunction.name: get_wgl_pay_extension_eligibility
pythonFunction.description:
Says whether the customer can still take a payment extension this billing cycle (one per cycle)
and the latest new due date allowed. Needs an identified caller. Before calling this tool, speak
a brief conversational pacing phrase while it runs.

Args:
    account_id: Account id of the identified account (REQUIRED).
    tenant: Injected by the system from tenant_id; leave empty.

Returns:
    dict with ok, eligible, max_new_due_date and reason.
